newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 841 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 841 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 841 contracts compared with 512 overnight Tuesday.
There were 26 wheat, 174 corn, 446 soybean, 40 soymeal, 31 soyoil, 21 corn calls, six corn puts, 52 soybean calls and 45 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 to 2-1/4 cents higher, corn was 1/4 higher to 1/2 lower and soybeans were steady to 2-1/4 cents higher.
